name: Tualatin Country Club
architects: George Junor (1913, the original nine, now the back nine); H. Chandler Egan (1919, the second nine, now the front nine); redesign by Bob Cupp and John Fought (1992); later work by Dan Hixson

world.note: provisional: OSM course boundary bbox (990 x 1074 m) + ~120 m scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (145 m west/east, 231 m south/north). Revisit once the boundary question (green north of the river) is settled.

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/52-tualatin-country-club/scorecard-and-layout), retrieved 2026-10-19; unverified third-party listing. Hole totals match the printed Out/In/Total for every tee set. GolfPass's tee table lists Member/Blue as 6,340 yd, 70.4/130, while its Blue column adds to 6,370.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Intake 2026-10-19. dtm / chm entries are added when the DOGAMI files arrive. The OSM extract has no golf=hole lines and no pins: hole routing is an open item.
